name: Ado

queries.query: Ado Nasarawa Nigeria official cadastral parcel GIS land registry map
queries.result: Found the official Nasarawa Geographic Information Service (NAGIS), which states that it is the state’s official GIS data source and hosts digital land administration; its official site lists a Karo service office in Ado, Nasarawa. No public parcel viewer or downloadable parcel geometry endpoint was identified.

officialSources.operator: Nasarawa Geographic Information Service (NAGIS), Nasarawa State Government
officialSources.evidence: NAGIS describes itself as a Nasarawa State Government agency, the only official GIS data source for the state, and the host of digital land-administration matters.
Official site describes a GIS/Land Administration System and lists the NAGIS Karo service office at Mararaban Gurku, Abuja–Keffi Expressway, Ado, Nasarawa.
Official registration procedure says survey data are captured in the GIS cadastral system and allocated to the land-information system; it is procedural evidence, not an open parcel API.
